summary: Add read-only GET /api/alerts/trends?days=N (default 7, min 1, max 90) returning exactly N UTC calendar-day buckets oldest-first for the last N days, each with a total alert-creation count and a per-severity breakdown (Low/Medium/High/Critical) including zero-count days and severities; invalid days returns 400 ValidationProblemDetails. Backend-only, no schema change.
scope_anchors: GET /api/alerts/trends?days=N (default 7, min 1, max 90; oldest-first UTC calendar-day buckets; per-day total + per-severity counts including zeros)
IAlertService.GetTrendsAsync / AlertManagementService.GetTrendsAsync (build contiguous oldest-first N-day range, zero-fill missing days/severities)
IAlertRepository / AlertRepository (grouped daily creation counts by severity over a UTC date range)
New DTOs: AlertTrendQueryRequest (days validation) + AlertTrendResponse / AlertTrendDayResponse (per-day buckets reusing AlertSeverityCountsResponse)
exact_source_files: AlertService.API/Services/AlertManagementService.cs (GetTrendsAsync: TimeProvider reference day, build oldest-first day range, zero-fill missing days/severities)
AlertService.Data.SQL/Repositories/AlertRepository.cs (server-side GroupBy on CreatedDate.Date + Severity over range, AsNoTracking, no SELECT *)
exact_source_files_extended: AlertService.DTO/Responses/AlertTrendDayResponse.cs (NEW: UTC date + total + AlertSeverityCountsResponse, reusing existing severity counts DTO)
constraints: days is a [FromQuery] param: default 7, min 1, max 90. Out-of-range or non-numeric input MUST return 400 ValidationProblemDetails via DataAnnotations [Range] + model binding, mirroring AlertQueryRequest (non-numeric binding failure already yields 400/ValidationProblemDetails).
Response has exactly N buckets, one per UTC calendar day, OLDEST FIRST. Window = UTC today back through today-(N-1) inclusive (N days including today).
DECISION: Reference 'today' comes from the injected TimeProvider.GetUtcNow() for deterministic/testable time; do NOT use DateTime.UtcNow directly in the service.
Bucketing by UTC calendar day = CreatedDate.Date (dates stored UTC). Every day in range appears even with zero alerts; every severity appears per day even when zero.
DECISION: Severity ordering mirrors the summary endpoint (Low, Medium, High, Critical); reuse AlertSeverityCountsResponse for per-day severity counts.

DECISION: Repository does server-side GroupBy on date + severity, AsNoTracking, no SELECT *, and returns raw grouped counts only. Zero-fill of missing days/severities happens in the SERVICE layer so the full contiguous oldest-first range logic is testable without a DB.
Keep EF/LINQ out of the controller and out of service business rules except the pure range/zero-fill assembly; DB grouping stays in the repository per service-architecture standards.
DECISION: Counting basis is CreatedDate (alert-creation volume) regardless of IsActive, per the story wording 'alert-creation counts'.
No schema/migration change, no auth change, backend-only (no UI).
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage on default (7 buckets), boundary days (1 and 90), invalid days (0, 91, non-numeric -> 400), oldest-first ordering, zero-fill of empty days and empty severities, and severity ordering matching the summary endpoint.
>=90% line coverage on changed controller/service/repository code per coding-standards.
